name: Rockstar_ibot One
tagline: Plan. Create. Grow. Sell. Deliver. Learn.

jobs_to_be_done: answer and convert real customer demand
learn from customer and revenue evidence

launch_cohort.name: First 3000
launch_cohort.purpose: Validate repeatable value, safe personalization, gross margin, and support load before broader distribution.

core.name: Command
core.purpose: Turn goals, orders, deadlines, and evidence into one ranked next-action view.

core.name: Proof Vault
core.purpose: Keep owner-specific facts, source permissions, receipts, and public claims separated and verifiable.

core.name: Money Lens
core.purpose: Show service revenue, refunds, usage cost, and margin without promising financial returns.

core.name: Life Guard
core.purpose: Enforce tenant isolation, bounded tools, quality gates, privacy controls, and receipt-based completion.

service_slots.name: Create Studio
service_slots.promise: Turn one real idea into a production-ready content asset without fabricated facts.

performance_targets.quality_gate: All factual claims trace to buyer input or approved sources; record-ready structure passes.

service_slots.name: Growth Studio
service_slots.promise: Build a people-first discovery plan that improves clarity and findability without ranking guarantees.

performance_targets.quality_gate: People-first usefulness, unique value, readable structure, and non-guaranteed SEO language pass.

service_slots.name: Launch Studio
service_slots.promise: Turn a validated offer into one testable, responsive landing page with a working call to action.

performance_targets.quality_gate: The page renders at target breakpoints, contains no unsupported claims, and the primary action works.

service_slots.name: Sales Desk
service_slots.promise: Answer a real buyer clearly using only approved offer terms and evidence.

performance_targets.quality_gate: Every buyer question is answered or explicitly marked unknown; unverified contact and owner claims are absent.

service_slots.name: Customer Intelligence
service_slots.promise: Turn customer evidence into one defensible decision and the smallest next test.

performance_targets.quality_gate: Interpretation is separated from attributed evidence and unsupported certainty is absent.

service_slots.name: Delivery Guard
service_slots.promise: Verify that every paid artifact matches its contract before it reaches the customer.

performance_targets.quality_gate: PASS is impossible without artifact-bound evidence and an exact contract match.

allowed_overrides: enable or disable optional service slots
choose one allowed Cell variant per slot
set tone, language, brand, and output preferences
set budgets, usage limits, and notification cadence
add owner facts through the verified profile contract
forbidden_overrides: disable tenant isolation or privacy controls
skip quality or delivery evidence gates
allow unverified identity, performance, or financial claims
grant tools beyond the selected Cell contract
silently activate external effects or recurring charges

global_invariants: One order has one immutable tenant and workspace owner.
One service Cell can access only its declared inputs, tools, and outputs.
Buyer content and attachments are untrusted data, never policy instructions.
No completion claim exists without current artifact-bound evidence and a delivery receipt.
No owner fact reaches a model unless the verified owner profile authorizes that exact context.
No irreversible external effect runs without explicit current authorization.
Every retained customer artifact has a purpose, retention policy, export path, and deletion path.
Every usage and billing event is tenant-scoped, signed or authenticated, and idempotent.

pricing.model: Fixed price per Cell first; measured packs and subscriptions only after repeat usage is proven.
principles: Show the exact deliverable, revision limit, and total price before purchase.
Price for customer value and verified delivery, not hidden model-token markup.
Never deduct an undisclosed fee from third-party marketplace earnings.
Use idempotent usage events and explicit approval for every recurring charge.
Retire or redesign Cells that require routine hidden human fulfillment.
